decisions.reason: The orientation verification is performed during manufacturing setup but is an independent review obligation; it does not change the account setup, upload destination, access method, or Basic-part review purpose.
Verifying physical component orientation does not change any component availability, sourcing, substitution, or fallback constraint.
The source adds coverage to the separate orientation-review Requirement and does not change which files or items the integrated-board production package must contain.
The orientation-review instruction does not alter the power-board BOM, component-role documentation, or required manufacturing exports.
Component-orientation verification does not change connector labels, QR codes, or other board-identification markings.
The requirement to verify every component's orientation does not modify the existing lead-free assembly constraint.
The source does not change the sensor-board BOM, Gerber, drill-file, or pick-and-place deliverables.
The orientation-review instruction does not change the main-board production package or resolve its previously reported missing components.
Checking component orientation does not change the confirmed through-hole assembly type or its coverage across connectors.
The source concerns assembly orientation of components, not board mounting orientation, connector placement, enclosure fit, or antenna-clearance layout.
The general orientation-review instruction does not alter the required handling or exposure of VRTC, VBACKUP, or PWROK.
Verifying component orientation does not change the button and switch pull-up configuration, active level, connector grounding, or press behavior.
